high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a rooftop or balcony, leaning against a white railing. The individual is wearing a green patterned top with long sleeves and has long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. They have their hands resting on their cheeks, with their elbows propped up on the railing. The person appears to be looking off to the side with a thoughtful or contemplative expression.
